name: ViaCEP
operator: ViaCEP free public CEP web service (viacep.com.br)
tier_rationale: Long-running free public CEP web service with public documentation, widely used by Brazilian systems (A8 community): 'Tiers (A8): BrasilAPI and ViaCEP community, IBGE trusted.' (P234 cond 4).

reliability.justification: Community relay of the Correios CEP base: street-level data for a CEP is usually right; the documented {'erro': true} marker (sent live as the string 'true') is its only absence signal (P234 cond 5).

cep.title: ViaCEP /ws/{cep}/json/ and reverse address search /ws/{UF}/{city}/{street}/json/

terms.quote: Tiers (A8): BrasilAPI and ViaCEP community, IBGE trusted.

cep.notes: Quote: binding council text (P234 cond 4); research C0555 terms 'Free public service' / 'ViaCEP free service.' Unknown CEP = HTTP 200 {'erro': true} (EMPTY, P234 cond 5; seen live 2026-11-26 as the string 'true'); a malformed CEP answers 400 HTML. Reverse search needs >= 3 characters per segment and returns at most 50 CEPs; it is used only for an analyst-typed address (P234 cond 7). No published limit, abusive volume gets the IP blocked: min_interval 1 s, 30-day cache (P234 cond 9). Used by cep_lookup.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G10-1 (P234 cep_lookup). Upstream family 'correios' like BrasilAPI CEP: a ViaCEP answer and a BrasilAPI answer relayed from ViaCEP are not independent. ttl 2592000 = 30 days (P234 cond 9), always capped by cache_max_age_days and retention_days. .br hosts default to Accept-Language pt-BR.
